text.tspan: Amazon SNS: publish once to a topic, every subscriber gets it
• Message 256 KiB default, up to 1 MiB (topic setting);
bigger via Extended Client Library (S3, 2 GB)
• Topic publish (SDK): create topic → create subscription(s)
• Direct publish (mobile apps SDK): create platform application
→ platform endpoint → publish. FCM (ex-GCM), APNs, ADM, Baidu, WNS
Security (same as SQS): in flight HTTPS · at rest KMS keys · client-side encryption
Access: IAM policies for the SNS API · SNS access policies (like S3 bucket policies) for cross-account access and to let other services (S3...) publish
